headline: Indian rupee strengthens to 93.27 per dollar on foreign equity inflows and lower oil
summary: The Indian rupee appreciated 24 paise to 93.27 against the US dollar in early trade, aided by reviving foreign portfolio inflows and falling global crude oil prices.
why: As a major net crude importer, India's currency and current account balance benefit directly from softer benchmark energy prices and overseas capital inflows.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Foreign capital inflows and declining oil import bills propelled the rupee higher against the dollar.
